definitions.explanation: A ticket purchased before the day of an event, typically at a discounted price compared to tickets sold at the door.

examples.japanese: {前売|まえう}り{券|けん}を{買|か}った。
{前売|まえう}り{券|けん}のほうが{当日|とうじつ}{券|けん}より{安|やす}い。
examples.english: Advance tickets are cheaper than same-day tickets.

examples.japanese: コンサートの{前売|まえう}り{券|けん}は{発売|はつばい}{開始|かいし}から{数分|すうふん}で{売|う}り{切|き}れた。
examples.english: The advance tickets for the concert sold out within minutes of going on sale.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound of {前売|まえう}り (advance sale) and {券|けん} (ticket). Advance tickets are standard in Japan for concerts, movies, exhibitions, and theme parks, and usually offer a discount over {当日|とうじつ}{券|けん} (same-day tickets).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {前売|まえう}り{券|けん}を{買|か}う (to buy an advance ticket)
- {前売|まえう}り{券|けん}が{売|う}り{切|き}れる (advance tickets sell out)
- {前売|まえう}り{券|けん}の{発売|はつばい} (release of advance tickets)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {当日|とうじつ}{券|けん}: same-day ticket — purchased on the day of the event
- {指定|してい}{席|せき}{券|けん}: reserved seat ticket — specifies a seat number
